import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] cnt = new int[10005];

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            ++cnt[x];
        }

        int k = sc.nextInt();

        int i = 1;
        while (i <= 3000) {
            cnt[i] += cnt[i - 1];
            ++i;
        }

        int ans = 0;
        int s = 1;
        while (s + k <= 5000) {
            ans = Math.max(ans, cnt[s + k] - cnt[s - 1]);
            ++s;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
